run_reference_path_example: run the reference_path_example function with geodesic_path mode to navigate an agent along a reference path
run_greedy_reference_path: run the reference_path_example function with greedy mode to navigate an agent using greedy path following
save_map_visualization: save an RGB observation with a top-down map and instruction text overlay to an images list
create_shortest_path_follower: create a ShortestPathFollower agent with a specified goal radius to navigate toward intermediate viewpoints
generate_navigation_video: generate a video from navigation step images using images_to_video for a given episode
